protocol.construction: Same diverse base seed, 50,000 additional reciprocal swaps minimizing the unchanged V2 pair/overlap objective; exact exposures preserved; no outcomes, triples or ranges
protocol.criterion: Mean advantage>=1percentage point versus diverse and uniform, Bonferroni2-comparison bootstrap lower bounds>0, positive leave-one-out means, mean8+ deterioration versus diverse<=0.2percentage point
protocol.uncertainty: 10,000 bootstrap resamples of whole seed replicates; approximate with24seeds, exploratory
protocol.historical: Reconstructed previously inspected validation dates; builders consume only seed, no outcomes
protocol.activation: None; no historical or synthetic holdout evaluated
